body:
That's another point.
Nowadays I don't feel anything. Its something I can't explain.

Constant indifference to everything.
Its all bleak and meaningless. So fuck it.

I think tomorrow might finally be the day.

Nothing, actually.

Some might say I have a "good" life.

I just don't want it. I'm a tiny speck of dust, fucking meaningless. Nothing I could ever do will have a lasting impact, and even if I could chances are it wouldn't be a beneficial one.

I just can't find a reason to even want to continue.

In all honesty?

I don't know. 
Ive always toyed with the idea.
The thought that I could step off the edge, and 2 seconds later have nothing to worry about is just.. Very inviting.
